name: Testing
description: Looping dots select archive media, with a persistent radio catalogue on Music.

files.testing.js: Manual composition/mount and seven ID-linked dot choices.
files.testing.css: Shared page reset and menu layering.
files.navigation.html: Seven One–Seven links using the preserved loop structure.
files.music-session.js: Lazy one-instance catalogue lifecycle and playback persistence across section changes.
files.music-validation.json: Music integration, audio persistence and publication checks.

mapping.label: Music
title: SNEEZE MULAN & PRINCESS JASMINE SKATEBOARDS
mapping.foreground: 28-item radio catalogue; original archive caption hidden while Music is active.

initial_state: Original separate sneeze22-bg default background; no selected option, thumbnails or caption. Reload restores this state.
behavior: Only7 options exist in the mounted interface; central ticker is removed in an inert template before insertion. Other14 captions/backgrounds are pruned.
Dot activation changes associated background image/video, thumbnails and text through the archive controller.
Mobile labels One–Six and Music; existing loop/docking and desktop fixed dots retained.
Loop scrolling only positions choices. Selection happens on click/tap/Enter, with drag-click suppression intact.
Caption thumbnail zoom is preserved. Hidden videos pause on selection change.
Music retains background1595537714238 while overlaying the radio catalogue. Music foreground replaces that option's old caption/thumbs.
Catalogue mounts once on first Music visit. Its single audio node remains outside the hidden visual section and continues playing on other dot selections.
Player bar is omitted. Only the playing card shows pause; clicking it pauses, and selecting another mix switches playback.
Loading completion cannot reopen Music after leaving; failed loading can be retried by reselecting Music.
integration: Load index.html as an isolated document. testing.js imports the existing controllers, fetches archive markup and navigation.html, and mounts once. mountTesting(host,archiveMarkup,navigationMarkup) returns destroy(). No external JavaScript dependencies added.

publication.status: updated Music implementation; deployment verification pending
